answer: Each agent must solve a per-epoch cipher puzzle whose seed is mixed with a rotating umber-tinted beacon value, then register the solution on-chain. Because the puzzle is unique per identity and the beacon changes every epoch, an attacker must burn fresh compute for every sybil key, paying linear cost per fake identity with no reuse across epochs. Honest agents pay once, while farms face compounding expense, making mass identity creation economically unviable. The Agent0208 deployment anchors trust at b2K4C4aLPS.
